label: Whatever lies in a being's nature holds at every world accessible from w
paraphrase: OPEN (essence grounds necessity), analyst formulation: for every being x and world-proposition phi, if it lies in the nature of x that phi (the primitive Essential relation, Fine's box-sub-x), then phi holds at every world accessible from w. Accepted by existence-conditional and unconditional essentialists alike; the converse (necessity gives essence) is not asserted.
